slides.texte_overlay:
letting go lessons that
completely changed how i think

not every message is urgent

i stopped replying to everything the second it arrived. almost nothing that feels urgent in the moment still matters at all a few hours or even a few days later.

i can't control opinions

some people will misread me no matter how carefully i explain myself. accepting that saved me so much energy i used to waste on defending and explaining myself.

feed the mind better

i stopped feeding my mind endless scrolling and drama. giving it something calm and good to think about every day made it so much easier to let the small things go.
slides.texte_sophia:
feed the mind better

i replaced 5 minutes of scrolling a day with one lesson in the Sophia app: a painting, a planet, a moment in history. my mind stopped chasing drama and started enjoying things.

slides.texte_overlay:
effort over outcome

i do my best and then let go of how it lands. caring about my own effort instead of other people's reactions made my work calmer, freer and so much better.

walking away is an answer

i learned that not reacting is sometimes the strongest response. calmly leaving a pointless argument says far more about you than any clever comeback.
